objective: Preallocate obsolete-SSTable deletion buffers from the known obsolete list upper bound.

tasks.title: Preallocate obsolete SSTable deletion list
tasks.result: Obsolete SSTable collection now reserves deletion-path capacity from the obsolete list length while holding the existing write lock.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The change uses the already-held obsolete_sstables write lock and does not add another lock acquisition.
The deletion loop still drops the lock before awaiting file removal.
